description: PM-10: the SHIPPED plan works for a player. No fixture and no test plan written to disk — the scenario starts on the real main menu and picks 'Orks — Recon Stomps on Hammer and Anvil' straight out of res://data/ai_plans/, which is the only way to prove the shipped content is reachable rather than just well-formed. Both seats are AI on recon_stomps; seat 1 gets the plan and seat 2 gets None, so the same army deploys twice on one board — once from the plan, once from the formula — and the screenshot IS the plan-vs-formula comparison. Adherence is then measured the honest way: every covered unit's DEPLOYED model positions are compared against the plan file's own coordinates not just counted as plan-sourced records. Reserves and attachments are checked on the board too, because a plan that places units correctly and then forgets to hold four of them back has not been followed.

steps.equals: Orks — Recon Stomps on Crucible | Orks — Recon Stomps on Hammer and Anvil

steps.script:
var m = tree.current_scene
var army = -1
for i in range(m.army_options.size()):
	if str(m.army_options[i].id) == "recon_stomps":
		army = i
m.player1_dropdown.selected = army
m.player1_dropdown.emit_signal("item_selected", army)
m.player2_dropdown.selected = army
m.player2_dropdown.emit_signal("item_selected", army)
m.player1_type_dropdown.selected = 1
m._on_player1_type_changed(1)
m.player2_type_dropdown.selected = 1
m._on_player2_type_changed(1)
return "p1=%s p2=%s" % [str(m.player1_plan_container.visible), str(m.player2_plan_container.visible)]

steps.equals: Orks — Recon Stomps on Hammer and Anvil

steps.script:
var d = tree.current_scene.player1_plan_dropdown
return d.get_item_text(d.selected).find("[") < 0
return tree.current_scene._selected_plan_value(1).ends_with("data/ai_plans/orks_recon_stomps_hammer_anvil.json")
return tree.current_scene._selected_plan_value(2)
return str(tree.current_scene.name)

var AIDM = load("res://scripts/AIDecisionMaker.gd")
return "%s|%s" % [str(AIDM.get_player_plan(1).get("name", "")), str(AIDM.get_player_plan(2).is_empty())]
steps.equals: Orks — Recon Stomps on Hammer and Anvil|true

steps.script:
# Wait until SEAT 1 — the plan seat — has resolved every unit: deployed (2)
# or in reserves (7). Two things this deliberately does NOT do:
#   * it does not wait on both seats. The FORMULA seat leaves a unit
#     undeployed on this board and the phase ends anyway, so an all-units
#     condition never becomes true and the scenario hangs.
#   * it does not key on the phase number. A fresh menu game starts in
#     FORMATIONS (0), not DEPLOYMENT (1), so 'phase != 1' is already true
#     before deployment begins and the snapshot would be taken of an empty
#     board.
var pending = 0
for uid in GameState.state.units.keys():
	var u = GameState.state.units[uid]
	if int(u.get("owner", 0)) != 1:
		continue
	if int(u.get("status", 0)) <= 1:
		pending += 1
return "seat1_done" if pending == 0 else "pending:%d" % pending

# PM-F5, now fixed. The plan declares NO embarkations and asks for both
# Gretchin mobs on obj_home_1; the AI used to load them into the Stompa
# regardless, which left the objective it is built around Uncontrolled. The
# formula's embarkation pass now skips any unit the plan places or reserves,
# so the AI must make exactly the embarkations the plan asked for — here,
# none at all. This step previously pinned the WRONG behaviour on purpose.
var plan_embarks = 0
var PV = load("res://scripts/PlanValidator.gd")
var plan = PV.load_plan_file("res://data/ai_plans/orks_recon_stomps_hammer_anvil.json")
plan_embarks = plan.get("deployment", {}).get("embarkations", []).size()
var forms = GameState.state.meta.get("formations", {}).get("1", {})
var loaded = []
for transport in forms.get("transport_embarkations", {}).keys():
	for passenger in forms["transport_embarkations"][transport]:
		loaded.append("%s->%s" % [str(passenger), str(transport)])
loaded.sort()
print("SCENARIO pm10 PM-F5: plan declares %d embarkation(s); the AI made %s" % [plan_embarks, str(loaded)])
return "plan=%d ai=%s" % [plan_embarks, ",".join(loaded)]

steps.equals: Plan: Orks — Recon Stomps on Hammer and Anvil (assigned)
